title: Airbus A320neo V2 (iniBuilds, MSFS 2024)
sources: Checked on the aircraft with this program (MSFS 2024, 2026-11-04): spoiler arm, ALT 100/1000 and ALT knob, baro, landing lights, APU BLEED, ENG MODE

The aircraft's WASM log (log.txt in the sim's WASM work folder of microsoft-aircraft-a320neo) and a check in flight (2026-11-06): ENG MASTER is L:INI_MIXTURE_RATIOn_HANDLE (data/panelstates: 0 cold and dark, 1 ready for takeoff); the aircraft drives the sim's mixture from it
The aircraft's throttle calibration (ThrottleData.ini, same folder): the FlyByWire throttle regions
MobiFlight HubHop presets for the iniBuilds A320 (hubhop.mobiflight.com)

entries.name: MIXTURE1_RICH
entries.note: The sim's mixture of engine 1, not the cockpit switch: lean stops the engine but ENG 1 MASTER does not move (seen 2026-11-06). Use ENG 1 MASTER instead.

entries.name: INI_MIXTURE_RATIO1_HANDLE
entries.note: Checked on the aircraft (2026-11-06, MSFS 2024, in flight): writing 0 to this L: variable alone stopped engine 1 at once ((A:GENERAL ENG COMBUSTION:1) 1 to 0) and the aircraft then set the sim's mixture to 0 itself; writing 1 put the mixture back to 100. It is the switch position the aircraft's panel states store (ini_mixture_ratioN_handle: 0 cold and dark, 1 ready for takeoff). A start still needs ENG MODE IGN/START (no relight was seen at FL430).
